Your questions, answered

A few things to know.

Is permanent lighting just for the holidays?

No. Your lighting stays installed year-round, so you can change the look for holidays, game days, celebrations, and everyday evenings.

How do I control the lights?

You control your lighting from your phone. We’ll discuss the system and its features as part of your custom quote.

Do you serve my area?

We serve approved ZIP codes across Colorado’s Front Range, including Erie, Broomfield, Lafayette, Louisville, Longmont, Boulder, Westminster, and north Arvada. Enter your ZIP code so we can confirm service at your home.

What happens after I request a quote?

Our team contacts you to discuss your home, answer questions, and gather the details needed for your custom estimate.
